summary: Fix Python discovery for both plugins on supported Bash runtimes, preserve guard denials and block guard startup failures, and check the actual launcher in readiness checks and CI.
migration: Compatibility scope: this patch fixes execution on the supported runtime; it is not support for older Claude Code or PowerShell-only installations. Use Claude Code 2.1.319 or later for onFailure: block, Python 3.8+, and Bash (Git Bash from Git for Windows on Windows, not the Windows/WSL Store alias). Upgrade missing prerequisites through the approved installation process, restart Claude Code, run each plugin's scripts/run-python.sh --check in Bash, then rerun delivery-doctor and metrics-usage-init --status. Do not disable guards, patch installed caches or create a python3 shim. Existing .enabler configuration, state, events and resumable runs need no format migration; guard startup failures now block rather than allowing unguarded execution. Maintainers must confirm this supported-runtime compatibility scope before release.
